analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 trading sessions. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while MACD histogram shows improvement. ADX at 26.4 indicates sustained trend strength, but the current price ($511.06) is positioned below SMA20 ($535.18) and SMA50 ($530.31), approaching resistance. Volume ratio at 0.82 relative to the 5-day average suggests a lack of conviction. While the overall market sentiment has shifted to 60% positive vs 40% negative, the individual stock exhibits a lack of clear direction, warranting a hold.
